ns2:course.label: MFA Graphic Design Studio
ns2:course.description: This studio provides the MFA design student with tools to further define and develop their body of work within the graphic design program's mission through an individual or collaborative path. The course will enhance a students' ability to inform their research with a rigorous theoretical framework that informs both viable research and pedagogical methods and processes. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 20 hours. Prerequisite: Enrollment in the MFA program in graphic design or consent of departmental graduate committee.
